description: Mixer, eight in and one out, with switches instead of knobs — an input reaches the output only while its switch is on

params.text: A switch passes at unity gain; right-click one and type any level from -100% to 100%

inputs.text: One of the eight signals summed to the output, and only while its own switch is on

outputs.text: The sum of the inputs whose switches are on, soft-clipped at 12V

notes: every switch starts off, so nothing reaches the output until switches are turned on
menu: Input gain — cuts every input before the mix: Unity, -3dB, -6dB or -12dB
Output clipping — Soft/saturated (better for audio) rounds the output off at 12V, Hard/clipped (better for CV) cuts it there and so sums CVs exactly, and None leaves it uncapped
Average — divides each output mix by the number of connected inputs instead of summing them
Inverting — Disabled stops a switch inverting at all; By param entry (right-click) allows a negative level to be typed; On second click makes a second click on a switch invert it
Exclusive switching — only one switch may be on at a time, so only one input reaches the output
